summary: Retest iteration 2 for the two critical bugs from iteration_1. Backend pytest 10/10 pass. Playwright E2E covered: admin login → /dashboard, CRM Add Client (create + list refresh), Projects New Project (create + grid refresh), and header logout. Both previously-broken flows now work end-to-end: modals close on success, new client and new project appear in the list without any error toast, and no 422 regressions were observed. No regressions in login/dashboard/sidebar navigation/logout.
critical_code_review_comments: Reusing full DB Pydantic models (Client, Project, Task, Lead) as request bodies still leaks internal fields to the API surface — consider dedicated *CreateRequest schemas long-term.
testIds.js AUTH.logoutButton='logout-button' vs Header.js uses 'header-logout-button' — cosmetic inconsistency, not blocking.
No global toast on failed writes; inline formError is a good local mitigation but a global axios error toast would improve UX for other pages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for retested flows (login, CRM add-client, Projects new-project, logout)

seed_data_creation: Playwright created TEST_Co_<ts> client and TEST_Proj_<ts> project during this run. No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_1 critical bugs (models.py Optional org/owner ids + inline formError UI) are verified fixed. If future features add new create-forms, apply the same pattern: mark internal-only fields Optional and surface backend detail via a formError state with data-testid='<entity>-form-error'.
rca of the issue: Previously frontend forms omitted organization_id/owner_id → Pydantic 422 before the endpoint's defaulting logic could run, and the modal swallowed the error. Fixed by making those fields Optional in models.py and by adding formError/submitting state in CRM.js and Projects.js. Verified in this iteration.
